title: Low stock threshold attribute _low_stock_amount not included in synchronisable attributes
body:
#### Can you reproduce this issue on default Wordpress theme (eg Storefront)?
yes

#### Can you reproduce this issue when all other plugins are disabled except WooCommerce, Polylang and Hyyan WooCommerce Polylang Integration?
yes

#### What product versions and settings are you using when this issue occurs?
* PHP: 7.4.2.1
* WordPress: 5.8.2
* WooCommerce: 6
* Polylang: [state if using Polylang PRO] 3.1.3
* Hyyan WooCommerce Polylang Integration: 1.5.1
* Browser: any


#### Steps to Reproduce
1. set up product and translation
1. set low stock threshold on product
1. save

#### What I Expected
low stock threshold should be synchronised to translation by default

#### What Happened Instead
low stock threshold not synchronised to translation

title: The visibility settings (catalogue) are not inherited correctly to the child product.

#### Can you reproduce this issue on default Wordpress theme (eg Storefront)?

#### Can you reproduce this issue when all other plugins are disabled except WooCommerce, Polylang and Hyyan WooCommerce Polylang Integration?

#### What product versions and settings are you using when this issue occurs?
* PHP: 7.3.13
* WordPress: 5.8.2
* WooCommerce: 7.3.13
* Polylang:  WP SYNTEX – 3.1.3 
* Hyyan WooCommerce Polylang Integration: 1.5.0 
* Browser: Firefox


#### Steps to Reproduce
1. I have set the visibility in the main product in the main language German to --> In the shop and the search results.
1. I go to the English product. In the child English product, however, the visibility is always set to Hidden. 
1. I cannot change it either.

#### What I Expected

The child english product should inherit the visibility settings from the main product.

#### What Happened Instead

The visibility settings remain on hidden

title: Product Reviews not activated
body:
<!--
Thanks for contributing—you rock!

Please note:
- These comments won't show up when you submit the issue.
- This is free software supported by volunteers in their spare time.  Please help us by making your issue report as clear and simple as possible.
If reporting a problem please make sure you confirm the following points so we can reproduce and fix your problem as quickly as possible:
-->

#### Can you reproduce this issue on default Wordpress theme (eg Storefront)?
Yes
#### Can you reproduce this issue when all other plugins are disabled except WooCommerce, Polylang and Hyyan WooCommerce Polylang Integration?
Yes
#### What product versions and settings are you using when this issue occurs?
* PHP: 
* WordPress: 5.8.1
* WooCommerce: Version 5.9.1 
* Polylang:  3.1.1
* Hyyan WooCommerce Polylang Integration: Version 1.5.0
* Browser: Google chrome


#### Steps to Reproduce
1. Go to product
2. Go to the advance tab
3. Enable product review
4. Go to the 2nd language product
5. try enabling the product reviews using step above
#### What I Expected
The "enable review" is greyed out.


#### What Happened Instead
Nothing. 

Good day! I just wanted to point out that when we checkmark “Enable product reviews” in the advance tab in the primary language it does not enable it in the 2nd language resulting in not having reviews displayed in the 2nd language.

The only way to enable review in the other language is to disable Hyyan WooCommerce plugin. Then checkmark the “Enable review” and then the reviews will be displayed.

Screenshot: https://prnt.sc/1tzp1jm

3. Activate the Fields Locker checkbox in the WooPoly options
4. Add a product in the secondary language (Spanish) and save it

#### What I Expected

The product fields should be able to be edited/selected/checked.

#### What Happened Instead

The product fields are locked and cannot be edited/selected/checked.

It seems that the Fields Locker script is always active when editing products in a secondary language even if there is no product in the default language to synchronize to. This is a fringe case, as usually one adds products in the default language first and then adds its translations. But, I think that the `addFieldsLocker()` function in the `Meta.php` file should check this.

https://github.com/hyyan/woo-poly-integration/blob/139469117798fc87a14863eb71c7c64ded49487f/src/Hyyan/WPI/Product/Meta.php#L724

2. Select one item in the shop
3. The breadcrumb shows HOME / SHOP / [ITEM CATEGORY] / [ITEM TITLE]
4. Switch language from ITALIAN to ENGLISH (flags on top left)
5. The breadcrumb shows HOME / [ITEM CATEGORY] / [ITEM TITLE] 



#### What I Expected
The breadcrumb should shows HOME / SHOP / [ITEM CATEGORY] / [ITEM TITLE] for both languages

#### What Happened Instead
Generally switching from the default language to english the path SHOP disappear from the breadcrumb inside woocommerce

Hi there,

I'm having some issues with some attributes on Cart.php on a website a manage. The attributes in question do have a translation. 

The problem leads to php timeouts error and sometimes users are not able to add products in the cart (wp_ajax returns 500). 

The error log reports:

```

Please let me know.

title: Product Edit setting  of Product Type is sometimes incorrect
body:
The javascript code in meta.php syncSelectedproductType() is intended to select the correct product type for new translations where the new product and type is not yet fully saved.  Ideally the whole _translation_porduct_type and this script should not be necessary and was removed at one point before further woo/wp updates made it necessary again.

However currently it is executing for all product edit screen loads and in some circumstances incorrectly sets the product back to Simple, possibly due to previous data corruptions.

Really this code should only be added and executed when needed to avoid potential problems.

title: "Out of stock" when selling a product with variations
body:
#### Can you reproduce this issue on default Wordpress theme (eg Storefront)?
Yes
#### Can you reproduce this issue when all other plugins are disabled except WooCommerce, Polylang and Hyyan WooCommerce Polylang Integration?

#### What product versions and settings are you using when this issue occurs?
* PHP: 7.3.27

title: When creating new variable translation, variations not visible until save
body:
commented by @charalampospapadop on #430
"Seems to work fine the only thing is that when i translate the product first time before i publish it , it does not show the variable products, then i publish it but they still wont show, i had to do 1 extra update after the publish, then they showed up. Thanks again."

Root cause is that get_children() no longer works when in new translation because Polylang adds filter for language taxonomy in wp_term_relationships 
even though a left join, because the where clause does not allow for no value, items with no taxonomy are filtered out, example WP_Query sql:

```
SELECT   wp_posts.* FROM wp_posts  
LEFT JOIN wp_term_relationships ON (wp_posts.ID = wp_term_relationships.object_id) WHERE 1=1  AND wp_posts.post_parent = 644  
 AND ( 
  wp_term_relationships.term_taxonomy_id IN (173)
) 
AND wp_posts.post_type = 'product_variation' AND ((wp_posts.post_status <> 'trash' AND wp_posts.post_status <> 'auto-draft')) GROUP BY wp_posts.ID ORDER BY wp_posts.post_date DESC 
```

on publishing the new translation, the hyyan synchronisation process re-synchronises so everything is resolved on refresh.

title: .bind() is deprecated in recent versions of jQuery
body:
As of jQuery 3.0, `.bind()` has been deprecated. It was superseded by the `.on()` method for attaching event handlers to a document.
In `/public/js/Cart.js` and `/public/js/Cart.min.js` there is a reference to `.bind()` that should be changed to `.on()` in order to work with recent versions of WP:

https://github.com/hyyan/woo-poly-integration/blob/383d3aa7ab16f9811344ed84ebb42539ec9e6b60/public/js/Cart.js#L225

`wp.customize.selectiveRefresh.bind( 'partial-content-rendered', function() {`

should be:

`wp.customize.selectiveRefresh.on( 'partial-content-rendered', function() {`

title: jQuery .attr() deprecated for use with the "disabled" property
body:
In both `/public/js/Variables.js` and `/public/js/Variables.min.js` files `.attr()` is used with the `disabled` property. jQuery has deprecated this use in its most recent versions, which WordPress is using now. jQuery now requires `.prop()` instead to set and retrieve the value of "checked", "selected" and "disabled" properties of a node.

https://github.com/hyyan/woo-poly-integration/blob/383d3aa7ab16f9811344ed84ebb42539ec9e6b60/public/js/Variables.js#L80

The line:

`this.$('#submitdiv *').attr('disabled', enable);`

should be:

`this.$('#submitdiv *').prop('disabled', enable);`

title: Synchronization Errors
body:
#### Can you reproduce this issue on default Wordpress theme (eg Storefront)?
yes
#### Can you reproduce this issue when all other plugins are disabled except WooCommerce, Polylang and Hyyan WooCommerce Polylang Integration?
yes
#### What product versions and settings are you using when this issue occurs?
* PHP: 7.4
* WordPress: 5.5.1
* WooCommerce: 4.5.2
* Polylang: 2.8.2
* Hyyan WooCommerce Polylang Integration: 1.4.3
* Browser: Google Chrome 


#### Steps to Reproduce
1. Update Product page in the first lang. ; Publish Or Update product page in the second lang.

#### What I Expected
when i publish the product page in the second i expect it to sync availability and to show stock the same as the product page in the first lang.
when i edit the page of the second language the page should run smoothly without lagging or freezing

#### What Happened Instead
i had the problem for variable products return to simple and i applied the resolve mentioned [here](https://github.com/hyyan/woo-poly-integration/issues/510) after that:
when i publish or update any of both lang. pages the second language page show as out of stock
when i publish or update any of both lang. pages the variations multiply in second language page, although they have stock the product page show out of stock
second problem when i load the second language product page it gets freezing and lagging 
these problems reproduce also with WP 5.4.2, WC 4.4.1, Hyyan 1.4.2
I'm now trying to use polylang for woocommerce combined with hyyan but it doesn't give me the expected functions and results

title: Inventory status does not synchronize when using the Stock Locations plugin for several warehouse locations
body:
**Can you reproduce this issue on default Wordpress theme (eg Storefront)?**

Yes.

**Can you reproduce this issue when all other plugins are disabled except WooCommerce, Polylang and Hyyan WooCommerce Polylang Integration?**

Yes.

**What product versions and settings are you using when this issue occurs?**
PHP: 7.2
WordPress: 5.4.2
WooCommerce: 4.4.1
Polylang: [state if using Polylang PRO] Free
Hyyan WooCommerce Polylang Integration: 1.4.3
Browser: Chrome

**Steps to Reproduce**

Hi! I'm using Your plugin with PolyLang and Stock Locations plugin (https://github.com/alexmigf/stock-locations-for-woocommerce) for multiple warehouse locations. When I create my product in two languages and place an order 
it doesn't change my stock properly. Every product in specific language behaves like a separate product with separate stock.
The stock quantity changes only for the language version of the product in which the language was set before placing an order.
Is there a way to handle this?

title: Variable Product Issue
body:

#### Can you reproduce this issue on default Wordpress theme (eg Storefront)?

Yes.

#### Can you reproduce this issue when all other plugins are disabled except WooCommerce, Polylang and Hyyan WooCommerce Polylang Integration?

Yes.

#### What product versions and settings are you using when this issue occurs?
* PHP: 7.3.21
* WordPress: Versión 5.5.1–es_ES
* WooCommerce: Versión 4.4.1
* Polylang: [state if using Polylang PRO] -> Free Versión 2.8.1
* Hyyan WooCommerce Polylang Integration: Versión 1.4.3
* Browser: Firefox 80.0.1 (64-bit)


#### Steps to Reproduce

Hello everybody.

Since this last wordpress + woocommerce + polylang update, I see a variable products issue, where everytime we save a product as variable product it back to simple product again. ------> OK: It was FIXED on this issue ( https://github.com/hyyan/woo-poly-integration/issues/510#issuecomment-687156776 ) **but all the following issues keep the same**:

**Because of this issue, on backend, when I choose again “variable product” I can’t see anymore the variation options detail (just the number of variations but I can’t click on it – it is stuck). When I disable “polylang + hyyan” plugins I can see variations options again in backend.**

If you edit the product without pay attention, there is a risk to save it as a simple product, so the product price will just disappear on frontend. To fix that (price disappearing), you have to edit the product, select again “variable product” and save it, so the price shows up again. -----> This part was fixed as well with the fix mentioned above.

**But I still having problem to see the Variatons, and the “select options” button became “read more” on frontend for variable products.**

Is there something I can do to fix that? Thanks.




#### What I Expected

After fix the forced simple product problem, I expected to back to see the variation options again. 


#### What Happened Instead

I can't see any variation options I created before. Only when I disable Polylang + Hyyan plugin, so I can see variable products again. (This happened before this mentioned fix above - and so, it is not the fix problem, actually, it happend just after the last Polylang + Woocommerce updates)

#### Can you reproduce this issue on default Wordpress theme (eg Storefront)?

#### Can you reproduce this issue when all other plugins are disabled except WooCommerce, Polylang and Hyyan WooCommerce Polylang Integration?

#### What product versions and settings are you using when this issue occurs?
* PHP: 7.2
* WordPress:   5.4.2
* WooCommerce: 4.4.1
* Polylang: [state if using Polylang PRO] Free
* Hyyan WooCommerce Polylang Integration: 1.4.3
* Browser: Chrome 85.0.4183.83


#### Steps to Reproduce
1.  Create Woo order in secondary language (either manually or via ordering product at front end)
1.  Receive woo mails (new order/order pending/order complete etc)  correctly sent in secondary language
1.  Open order in woocommerce backend and trigger a refund or manually send order details via "Order Actions"
 

#### What I Expected
Manually triggered emails for refunds or order details to be sent in secondary language (as per all other other emails to this client)


#### What Happened Instead
Manually triggered emails for refunds etc were sent in system default language

title: Combatibility issues between WooCommerce Product Add-ons plugin and Polylang
body:
Hello, i am having a strange bug when i use woocomerce product addon plugin to add a price field to modify the Subtotal of a product.

1)First in the product page the addition of the price is included in the subtotal like it should be (Screenshot bellow).
![product-page-screenshot](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/67193199/85202331-5b3f2380-b30e-11ea-8715-baffa8e6e887.PNG)

2)The problem is that when the product have been added to the cart, the subtotal is wrong. (it shows the price without the addition) (Screenshot bellow).
![cart-screenshot](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/67193199/85202434-1bc50700-b30f-11ea-901e-50f6334a022d.PNG)

I have tried to find the case for this issue, by activating the default theme of wordpress and by deactivating all plugins, and activating step by step to find if it is a compatibility issue between some plugins.
Doing that i find that by deactivating the polylang and hyyan woo-poly-integration plugin that the issue have been removed.

Can you please help me fix this issue?

Bellow you will find my website settings:
PHP: 5.3.3
Wordpress: 5.3.4
WooCommerce: 4.2.0
Polylang: 2.7.3
Hyyan WooCommerce Polylang Integration: 1.4.3
Browser: Chrome and Firefox

It has happened at least 5 times now, the click fix is to open a product and just click update without changing anything.

title: Problem with cart page
body:

If reporting a problem please make sure you confirm the following points so we can reproduce and fix your problem as quickly as possible:
-->

 Can you reproduce this issue on default Wordpress theme (eg Storefront)?

Yes: 
The additional content for emails is not added to string translations

#### Can you reproduce this issue when all other plugins are disabled except WooCommerce, Polylang and Hyyan WooCommerce Polylang Integration?
Yes

#### What product versions and settings are you using when this issue occurs?
* PHP: 7.2
* WordPress: 5.2.3
* WooCommerce: 3.7
* Polylang: free
* Hyyan WooCommerce Polylang Integration: 1.4.3
* Browser: All

I have added the additional_content field to the string translation by rewritting
 ```PHP
public function registerString($email_type, $sufix = '') 
 ```


and adding 
  ```PHP 
if (isset($settings['additional_content' . $sufix])) {
      pll_register_string('woocommerce_' . $email_type . '_additional_content' . $sufix, $settings['additional_content' . $sufix], __('WooCommerce Emails', 'woo-poly-integration'));
} 
```
 after the recipient field

It's a pretty easy fix, let me know if I should submit a pull request to add the feature :)

The plugin can not function correctly , the plugin requires minimum plugin versions WooCommerce version 3 or higher and Polylang 2 or higher. Please configure Polylang by adding a language before activating WooCommerce Polylang Integration.See alsoInstallation Guide.

===========================

Thank you very much for your help!

title: Notices when WooCommerce pages missing
body:
Great plugin.  I have a use case though I don't think has been considered before and the "create missing WC pages" feature of this plugin is super annoying.  Perhaps there's scope to change a few bits..

My shop doesn't need a basket, checkout or my-account page.  I'm using WC as a catalog, which I think is quite typical.  I would expect the Settings > WooPoly > "Check WooCommerce Pages" option, if unticked, to disable all those checks.

#### Can you reproduce this issue on default Wordpress theme (eg Storefront)?
Yes

#### Can you reproduce this issue when all other plugins are disabled except WooCommerce, Polylang and Hyyan WooCommerce Polylang Integration?
Yes

#### What product versions and settings are you using when this issue occurs?
* PHP: 7.2
* WordPress: 5.2.3
* WooCommerce: 3.7.0
* Polylang: [state if using Polylang PRO] Free version
* Hyyan WooCommerce Polylang Integration: 1.4.3
* Browser: Chrome


#### Steps to Reproduce
1. Install WC
1. delete all WC pages
1. install WooPoly
1. go into WooPoly settings and untick "Check WooCommerce Pages"
1. delete all WC pages (because you don't need them) except the shop page
1. refresh any admin page and WooPoly warns that the shop won't work without WC pages

#### What I Expected
In the last step above I would expect WooPoly not to warn me because I have unselected the  "Check WooCommerce Pages" option.


#### What Happened Instead
On every admin page, WooPoly warns that loads of WC pages are missing.  It's frustrating because the functionality is exactly as I want it.  It's perfect.  Except I have these warnings all over the place.  Warnings that are in fact false for a catalog use case.

So what I feel is needed is to remove all those WC page checks if that option is unselected.  (actually do what that setting claims).

Thanks in advance!

I'm getting this error in the console on Pages where no woocommerce products are addable to cart. (Impressum pages etc.). Can we add a check if Cookies is loaded, before using them?
```
Cart.min.js?ver=1.4.3:1 Uncaught ReferenceError: Cookies is not defined
    at HTMLDocument.<anonymous> (Cart.min.js?ver=1.4.3:1)
    at i (jquery.js?ver=1.12.4-wp:2)
    at Object.fireWith [as resolveWith] (jquery.js?ver=1.12.4-wp:2)
    at Function.ready (jquery.js?ver=1.12.4-wp:2)
    at HTMLDocument.J (jquery.js?ver=1.12.4-wp:2)
```
